skill.name: real-time-filtering
skill.description: Patterns for real-time client-side filtering, searching, and sorting of lists. Use when implementing dynamic search or filter features.
skill.body:
## When to use this skill

Use this skill when implementing search, filtering, or sorting of list data in components. Covers client-side performance optimization and responsive UX patterns.

For detailed patterns, implementation examples and best practices, see [references/REFERENCE.md](references/REFERENCE.md).

For project-specific filtering patterns, refer to `.context/CLAUDE.md` or `.context/COPILOT.md`.

generated_query: I'm working on a project management dashboard that displays a list of tasks. Each task has fields: id, title, status (open, in progress, done), priority (low, medium, high), assignee, and due date. I have a JSON array of about 500 tasks. I need to add a real-time search box that filters tasks as the user types, along with dropdown filters for status and priority, and a sort option (by due date or priority). The filtering and sorting should happen instantly on the client side without any server round trips. The UI is a table that updates smoothly. Can you help me implement this in React? Specifically, I need to decide on the state management approach and ensure the filtering logic doesn't cause performance issues when typing quickly. Please provide code examples and best practices for handling debouncing, case‑insensitive search, and combining multiple filters.

edit_instructions.target_text: Covers client-side performance optimization and responsive UX patterns.
edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the explicit performance optimization coverage makes the skill appear to ignore the user's concern about quick typing and debouncing.
